name: Spend breakdown donut
summary: Spend split into four categories as a donut with the total in the middle, and a legend that lists each amount and share.
use: for showing how a total splits into a few categories
a11y: The drawing is hidden from screen readers; the legend list carries every category, amount and share, and its label gives the total.

use_when: a billing or usage page that needs the total and each category's amount and share side by side
avoid_when: more than four categories, or values to compare over time: use bar-chart
a few headline numbers with no part-of-a-whole split: use kpi-strip
spending against limits per category: use budget-meters

parts.name: title
parts.what: what is being split, the one heading

parts.name: ring
parts.what: the donut, one segment per category, hidden from screen readers

parts.name: total
parts.what: the rounded total in the middle, with a short caption

parts.name: legend
parts.what: one category: colour dot, name with a usage note, amount and share; hovering it lifts its segment

parts.name: foot
parts.what: a note under the chart, such as credits or a trend

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the numbers fail to load, keep the heading and put an alert-banners line in place of the chart and legend

disabled.how: the chart has no controls; to mark stale data, lower the ring's opacity and say so in the foot

overflow.how: below about 480px the ring sits above the legend instead of beside it, and shrinks further on phones

long_text.how: a long category name wraps in its own column while amount and share keep their width
